articles.summary: Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – September 14, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) provides an update to our second-half capital program and 2026 guidance (all amounts are in Canadian dollars unless otherwise noted). Obsidian Energy Provides an Operational and Guidance Update Highlights: Second-half 2026 development program advancing with two rigs active in each of Peace River and Willesden Green 2026 production guidance revised to 28,500–29,500 boe/d, due to weather-related development delays and third-party facility downtime at the recently acquired Belly River assets which has been restored to ~2,400 boe/d…
articles.title: Obsidian Energy Provides an Operational and Guidance Update
